description: Source code for AI movement logic in the Battle for Wesnoth game, including pathfinding, target selection, group movement, and threat assessment.

classes.name: move_cost_calculator
classes.description: Calculates movement cost for units considering terrain, enemies, and other factors.

methods.name: ai::find_targets
methods.description: Finds potential targets for units, including threats, villages, and explicit targets.

methods.name: ai::form_group
methods.description: Forms a group of units along a route, considering reachability.

methods.name: ai::enemies_along_path
methods.description: Identifies enemy units along a given path.

methods.name: ai::move_group
methods.description: Moves a group of units along a route, considering defense and positioning.

methods.name: ai::rate_group
methods.description: Rates the strength of a group of units based on defense and attack capabilities.

methods.name: ai::compare_groups
methods.description: Compares the strength of two groups.

methods.name: ai::choose_move
methods.description: Selects the best move for a unit to pursue targets, considering pathfinding and threat levels.

methods.name: ai::access_points
methods.description: Calculates access points for units to reach a destination within movement limits.
